Use case: scientific-educational. One nine-cell square transparent illustration atlas for an original first-grade organizing and arcade lesson. Exact equal invisible 3×3 grid, centered illustration in each specified cell and 13% completely transparent margin at every cell edge. All nine are separate, no visible grids, text, digits, tags, logos, fake arrows or ground shadows. Fine paper texture, matte gouache, clean cut-paper shapes, soft warm cream, muted apricot and pine green. Keep strong silhouettes. Draw the two toy-cart animation frames strictly from overhead with a distinctive apricot open basket, deep green handle, two dark wheels on each side. 
R1C1: this cart from directly above, facing upward, in full view, open basket empty. Two wheel pairs and the handle easy to see.
R1C2: same cart from directly above, exactly the same angle, direction, scale, handle, wheelbase and exterior silhouette. One neatly folded teal fabric bundle now lies inside its basket. No extra cargo and no speed lines.
R1C3: one DIFFERENT small olive-green campus delivery wagon seen in strict side elevation, one long horizontal body and two wide wheels, distinct from the top-down player cart, no road.
R2C1: one wide quiet horizontal rectangle of warm deep pine-green matte workroom road background texture, nearly flat fine paper grain, with no roads painted in, no grid, no objects, no marks. Real transparent outside rectangle only.
R2C2: one original overhead pale-sage worktable vignette, show exactly one wide orange art album, one unmarked teal straightedge, one round orange ribbon roll partly obscured by the album, and two loose blocks (one cream and one blue), empty divided coral tray on the right. These are the same objects as the next cell.
R2C3: exactly the same table and objects after organizing: same orange art album moved to the left, orange ribbon roll exposed and reachable beside it, same teal straightedge resting in the long bay of the same coral divided tray, cream and blue blocks in short bay. No extra objects. Use same relative scale as R2C2.
R3C1: one open beige cloth tote seen from above front, two small loop handles, one large cavity holding softly colored clean safe cloth props together. Entire silhouette visible.
R3C2: one dark teal school backpack with contrasting cream zipper edging opened in a three-quarter front view; show one broad main cavity holding a horizontal orange album, one shallow front zip pouch with an orange ribbon roll, and one side mesh pocket with a pale-blue water bottle and gold cap. All three compartments visibly distinct.
R3C3: one compact wide original low arts corner vignette containing three distinct storage places arranged left to right: a soft low apron hook with one apron, a shallow divided tray for one unmarked teal straightedge and chunky blocks, and a small lidded block container resting inside a larger plain chest. No children or writing.
